$comment: Checked by hand in a rule already in force: the debt left when these standards were activated, before the Oracle ruled (2026-10-04) that no rule leaves draft while a row of its Check table is verified by hand (PRO-023, step 7). regime.test.mjs fails if a standard in force gains a hand-checked row not listed here, and if a row listed here is no longer checked by hand (delete it: the list only shrinks).
